children: LandBridge Co. LLC (LB) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 21, 2026.

On September 18, 2026, Jason Williams, Executive Vice President and Chief Administrative Officer of LandBridge Company LLC (the "Company"), who currently serves as the Company's principal accounting officer, notified the Company of his intent to retire from the Company in July 2027. Mr. Williams will continue to serve as the Executive Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer, and as the principal accounting officer, of the Company until a successor is identified. Mr. Williams also notified the Company that he intends to transition to an advisory role with the Company following his retirement in order to, among other matters, ensure a smooth succession.
Mr. Williams' retirement is not the result of any disagreement with the Company's operations, policies or practices.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1995807/000119312526396773/lb-20260918.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1995807/000119312526396773/0001193125-26-396773-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
